issue_request: FHIR-23965 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Change Request for ImplementationGuide. Commit 83a633c206c56eee8492fda361afbf6418fee8e8 later updated the ImplementationGuide example instance to use profile instead of exampleCanonical.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ImplementationGuide as an active resource. Later FHIR-44784 refined profile wording for non-example resources and is already represented on the combined branch.
